description: Check a support ticket you filed earlier and read the Tendeck team's reply or fix. Call it with the ticket and the status_token that support_report returned; when you are signed in to the same workspace you can pass the ticket alone. Tell the user plainly what the reply says and whether they need to do anything.

status_token.description: The status_token support_report returned (not needed when signed in).
